scope: D8 inherited outcome labels, heterogeneous reference standards and uncertain annotation blinding

studies.read_level_this_stage: Previously reviewed full text revisited for reference standard and distinct segmentation procedures
source_locators: Methods / Tumor segmentation / Standard BraTS segmentation
Methods / Tumor segmentation / Cellular tumor segmentation

facts.standard_BraTS: OnQ automated segmentation, radiologist correction and neuroradiologist approval
facts.cellular_tumor_masks: Explicitly used clinical, pathological and imaging history including prior and subsequent MRI

studies.limits: The cellular-tumor annotation procedure cannot be assigned to the supplied BraTS masks. Blinding of correction for the supplied BraTS mask is unconfirmed. Aggregate pathology counts do not establish pathology-confirmed counts in the 182-examination subset. No independent diagnostic readjudication performed.

studies.read_level_this_stage: Previously reviewed official full checklist revisited for reference-standard items 14-16

facts.item14: Definition of methods used to obtain reference standard
facts.item15: Rationale for choosing the reference standard

studies.limits: Checklist supports transparent reporting, not evidence that our labels are correct, that leakage occurred, or a calculated quality score.

own_study_claims.claim: Tumor labels equal complement of the 51-case negative list in all three existing cohort tables
Workbook subtypes differ from the published source while broad binary counts agree
Production features use union of positive standard BraTS labels, not cellular-tumor masks
Patient grouping excludes cross-fold patient overlap, not upstream reference or annotation bias

interpretations: Clinical and imaging assessment in the reference standard creates possible reference/index-data dependence; direction and magnitude not measured
Subtype discrepancies remain unresolved; broad labels do not support subtype-specific diagnostic claims
Unknown blinding is a potential bias concern, not proof of leakage
Independent adjudication and documented annotation are recommendations, not completed work
access_notes: Current web opens to PMC and Nature did not return article text; primary full text already cached was directly parsed and read. Current primary search also confirmed the published partition. No new source acquisition or new full-text-review count.
